# WpfMath attribution

This library contains the unmodified WpfMath library source and font resources from XAML-Math 2.1.0:

- Repository: https://github.com/ForNeVeR/xaml-math
- Exact commit: d6f576345998777dcf7ad112da1add9bd7ad9674 (tag v2.1.0).
- Upstream code license: MIT; see LICENSE.md.
- Font licenses: Fonts/LICENSES.md and PrintMaster's Assets/Licenses/WpfMath/Fonts notices.

PrintMaster adds one public factory/wrapper file and adapts the build project. This fork is built locally for PrintMaster; it is not an official NuGet release. Upstream source files and font bytes have not been modified. The font files retain their original names and licenses and are not installed system-wide.
